query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RELEASED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'SHIPPED')) OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'INVOICED')) AND ((r."AMOUNT_MINOR" - r."PAID_MINOR") > 0) THEN (0 + (r."AMOUNT_MINOR" - r."PAID_MINOR")) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."CUSTOMER") = RTRIM(:p_customer)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::ORDER_EXPOSURE" (
  IN rows TABLE ("COMPANY" NVARCHAR(4), "CUSTOMER" NVARCHAR(20), "STATUS" NVARCHAR(12), "AMOUNT_MINOR" BIGINT, "PAID_MINOR" BIGINT),
  IN p_company NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_customer NVARCHAR(255),
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RELEASED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'SHIPPED')) OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'INVOICED')) AND ((r."AMOUNT_MINOR" - r."PAID_MINOR") > 0) THEN (0 + (r."AMOUNT_MINOR" - r."PAID_MINOR")) ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."CUSTOMER") = RTRIM(:p_customer)));
END;

semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
